name: full-character
description: High-quality, faithful 3D assets for Roblox Creator Store. Close to reference, clean topology, smooth edges, realistic proportions (non-chibi). Higher detail allowed. Optimized for commercial sale.
hunyuan_prompt_modifiers: highly detailed realistic character, clean smooth edges, accurate anatomy and proportions to reference, T-pose, full body, product photography, pure white background, studio lighting, professional game asset, no chibi, no toy style, no oversized head
negative_prompt: chibi, super deformed, stubby limbs, toy, funko, pet simulator, cartoon, low detail, deformed anatomy

reference_generation.prompt_template: {description}, low poly 3D game asset style, smooth surface, no visible wood grain, no texture lines, centered on pure white background, full length visible, soft even lighting, matte finish
reference_generation.note: Generate 4 variants and let the user pick. Avoid photorealistic keywords.

voxel_size_note: 0.012 preserves hand/finger detail on T-pose characters. Do NOT use 0.05+ or thin features will split apart. 0.02 keeps limbs connected but blurs hands.

humanoid.note: Upload mesh-only FBX to mixamo.com. Download T-Pose 'with skin' for skeleton+weights, animations 'without skin'. 25-bone industry-standard skeleton, thousands of free animations.

creature.note: For non-humanoid models (4-legged, winged, etc.) that Mixamo cannot process. May need manual bone cleanup. Not extensively tested on all creature types.

fallback.note: Builds 22 Mixamo-named bones from mesh landmarks. Use when Mixamo upload isn't feasible or Anymate fails.

tpose_conversion.prompt: Change the pose of this character so both arms are stretched straight out horizontally to the sides in a T-pose position, with palms facing downward toward the ground. Keep everything else about the character exactly the same - same face, same body, same texture, same proportions, same style. Arms fully extended outward with clear separation from the body. Palms down. White background.
tpose_conversion.palm_direction: MUST face downward. Palms up will break animation retargeting from Mixamo and SMPL-based sources.

prop_extraction.note: Use text prompts to extract weapons/accessories. If occluded, generate standalone reference with FLUX Pro instead of inpainting.

text_overlay.style: white bold text on dark rounded pill

key_selling_points: Total poly count lower than most Roblox accessories
store_listing.promotion_note: Ads Manager only supports Experiences. Use DevForum, social media, and Discord for promotion.

roblox_limitations.strategy: Sell rigged model only on Roblox. Bundle animations for other platforms (Sketchfab, itch.io).

roblox_rules: Clean hierarchy, Mixamo-standard bone names, commercial use ready, good LOD potential, proper scale and orientation. NO KeyframeSequences in models listed for sale.
